hook: orphan 縮減團壓行李：wane／dwindle／atrophy／abridge——海關問「這是減重還是偷渡空氣？」
script: wane／dwindle 縮小。atrophy 萎縮。abridge 刪節。curtail 縮減。taper 逐漸變細。口令：行李寫「精簡」，別把意義也壓扁。

members.senseAnchor: to decrease in size, extent or degree
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 月虧: wane walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「月虧」出場：wane 一上場梗就黏住——減退。

related.antonyms: wax, accept, ascent, better, improvement, intensify, increase, amplify
